title: Unblock deploys and place Nicole's 21 Oct uploads
userRequest: can you fix the preview image? unconditional drop overload is showing now
description:
Editor uploads from the CMS (root-level files in public/images) no longer block deploys: isUploadInboxFile exempts them from the media/credit guards, while curated folders keep the strict rule. Today's uploads are handled: duplicate copies deleted, the layout mockup moved out of the site, and three event photos placed in the London chapter gallery (Nicole still has to confirm London is right). At the user's request, chapter and community leads can now carry a headshot: Nemo Shi (London Lead) and Stefan Pagacik (Investor Community Digital Lead) show round headshots beside their names. Also fixed a race in the project's seed adapter that left content collections empty during scenario captures (it now waits and refreshes again before failing).

Scope verdict: no project deliverable was fully delivered or newly deferred this cycle. It moves 'bring all content to publication quality' forward (two lead headshots, three London photos); that deliverable stays open because it still needs team-supplied material. The full lead-profile layout from Nicole's mockup is deferred to its own lead-profiles plan. All deferral decisions were made by the user; none were made by the agent alone.
